name: Jonathan Coppola
headline: Technical curriculum developer · Program manager · Baritenor · Game master
intro: I turn complex security and product concepts into practical learning. By day I build hands-on labs and courses for Darktrace's AI-driven cyber defense platform. By night I'm onstage in Tampa Bay community theater, or behind a GM screen running a campaign for my friends. What ties it together is telling a story so the people in the room want to lean in.
summary: Technical curriculum developer with a software engineering background and 6+ years at Darktrace building hands-on labs, e-learning courses and training for its AI-driven cyber defense platform. Experienced in C#, SQL, REST API development and database engineering, with a Master's in Cybersecurity. I turn complex security and product concepts into practical learning for technical audiences, sustaining an 83 NPS across thousands of learners.

roles.title: Program Manager, Enablement of Technical Product Content
bullets: Lead the conversion of 24 instructor-led training (ILT) manuals into hands-on e-learning labs and courses across 7 Darktrace product lines, coordinating product, engineering and education teams
Own planning, prioritization and delivery timelines for enablement releases aligned to product launches

roles.title: Cyber Defense Educator / Curriculum Developer
bullets: Deliver technical training on Darktrace's AI-driven cyber defense platform to customers, partners and internal analysts, covering threat detection, investigation and response workflows
Develop and maintain curriculum, labs and learning materials, keeping content current with frequent product releases
Trained thousands of learners across 13 courses, sustaining an 83 Net Promoter Score over 6 years
Helped build Darktrace's Email product training course from the ground up

roles.title: Data Developer
bullets: Built and maintained databases and data processes supporting client operations using Visual Basic and Microsoft Access
Created and maintained internal and external KPI reports used by leadership to track performance
Built a Microsoft Access and Visual Basic data bridge to migrate client companies' legacy asset-management data into IBM Maximo

roles.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Developed a C# REST API wrapper around a client's Silverlight-based quality control system, extending its life without rebuilding the database interface and enabling multi-browser support
Built a Kendo HTML5 / MVC Razor and JavaScript user interface that mirrored the legacy design, keeping user retraining minimal at launch
Applied Agile methods and Secure SDLC practices in testing to ensure application security

education.degree: Bachelor of Science, Management Information Systems
education.notes: Honors College · Lead organizer, 5th Annual Chinese Culture Festival (2015)

publications.title: Suspicion in Phishing and Organizational Risk
publications.summary: Research and literary analysis of suspicion as an emotion as it relates to phishing scams and the risk they pose to organizations.

stage.blurb: I grew up in choir and marching band, and found my way back to the stage as an adult through Tampa Bay community theater. I love ensemble storytelling, accents, and the moment a whole cast lands a harmony.

tabletop.blurb: I'm a game master at heart. I build worlds around situations rather than railroads, give players real choices, and always leave a hook dangling at the end of the night.
